open_window_rebuilds.reason: opening a 400-item thread rebuilds the window for mounting, navigation, host state, composer sizing, the landing and the project's first icon and repository reads, which the measurement now waits for; measured 8 to 11

open_section_refreshes.reason: section refreshes are cheaper than window rebuilds, so moving opening work into them stays within budget; measured 0 to 1

open_retained_kib.reason: launching into a 400-item thread retains about 6.9 MiB of heap (Editor plus the in-process Forge); the rest is headroom for allocator and font differences between machines

open_allocated_kib.reason: launching into a 400-item thread allocates about 350 to 410 MiB on the UI thread (resources, fonts, the first realization and every frame until the landing settles); it varies with how many frames run before Forge answers, so the limit carries that spread

idle_window_rebuilds.reason: a settled thread with no input and no new items must not rebuild or refresh anything

idle_frames_requested.reason: a settled thread must not request frames or animation deadlines, or the Editor burns CPU while idle

idle_access_nodes_published.reason: a connected screen reader must receive nothing while the window is unchanged

idle_allocated_kib_per_frame.reason: a settled frame with nothing to rebuild still drains the host and builds an empty scene; measured 224

rest_access_nodes.reason: the accessibility tree covers only realized rows, not all 400 items; measured 775

stream_window_rebuilds.reason: live deltas past the 16 KiB inline limit, with the reply persisted as stored content every sixth delta, refresh only the transcript section; measured 0, and the margin covers one late host-wide change landing mid-stream

stream_section_refreshes_per_frame.reason: a frame refreshes the transcript at most once while a reply streams

stream_access_nodes_published_per_frame.reason: each delta adds a row and the transcript follows the tail by it, so every realized node moves and is republished with its new bounds; measured 630 to 705

stream_allocated_kib_per_frame.reason: a streamed delta realizes only the reply's new and previous tail blocks, because sealed blocks are keyed by their content; measured about 3200, and realizing every block of the reply on each delta measures about 13000

finish_window_rebuilds.reason: a reply that finishes as stored content refreshes only the transcript section; measured 0, and the margin covers one late host-wide change

finish_section_refreshes_per_frame.reason: swapping the live text for the stored text refreshes the transcript when the stored rows publish and once more when their measured heights invalidate them in the same frame; measured 2

finish_access_nodes_published_per_frame.reason: swapping the live text for the stored text redraws the realized window once; measured 1299

finish_allocated_kib_per_frame.reason: swapping the live text for the stored text realizes the reply's blocks once; measured about 15100

scroll_window_rebuilds.reason: older pages that arrive while scrolling refresh only the transcript section; measured 1 (views_frame), and the margin covers a late host-wide change

scroll_section_refreshes_per_frame.reason: a frame refreshes the transcript once for the scroll and at most once more when newly realized rows invalidate themselves after measuring; measured 2

scroll_access_nodes_examined_per_frame.reason: each scrolled frame hands the screen-reader bridge the realized rows only; measured 1360

scroll_access_nodes_published_per_frame.reason: a scrolled frame republishes only the nodes that moved into or out of view; measured 223 on Linux and 325 on the Windows CI runner
